pr_title: changefeedccl: refactor: move avro to its own package
pr_body:
Refactor avro.go and avro_test.go into their own
package, so they can be reused in the enriched
envelope json schema generation.

Epic: CRDB-8665
Fixes: #139655

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/140397)

issue_context.title: Metadata/Enriched envelope: Refactor avro schema system, so it can be reused for json's schema
issue_context.body:
Leverage and add to existing code for avro schema generation so that it can be used to generate the schema for Enriched envelope for both json and avro. 

Epic CRDB-8665
Jira issue: CRDB-46758
